question: Can an external SAM3-distilled doorway/door instance source retain door-level portal boxes while abstaining on source-proved no-portal views and large doorless station or market mouths?

representation.name: Specialized Door Ontology Proposer
representation.single_change: Replace generic ADE20K door pixels and direct VLM typing with a task-specialized YOLO26n instance source trained to separate doorway, door, people, window, and internal mirror classes.
representation.why_different: The new evidence is an externally trained, portal-specific instance ontology distilled from SAM3 across ADE20K, DoorDetect, Trans10K-v2, COCO-person, and walkthrough data. No prior L10 threshold, component, prompt, candidate geometry, or appearance matcher is reused.
representation.authority_separation: The source never receives the requested entity name or OCR. It proposes only generic class-0 doorway and class-1 door boxes; frozen SCIL separately attaches source identity.

model.license: AGPL-3.0; internal research only pending any product-integration license review
model.training_boundary: The public card lists training families but not a complete image inventory. PB7 is algorithmically unseen by this evaluator, but training-source disjointness is not claimed.

author_contract.candidate_ranking: After the unmodified author postprocessor, sort class-0/1 boxes by descending confidence, then class id and box coordinates; retain Top-3.
author_contract.defaults: All other inference and NMS behavior is frozen to Ultralytics 8.4.102 defaults. No crop, TTA, area/scale filter, class change, window veto, threshold change, or model comparison.

development_cohort.authority: The eight PB7 images are consumed Development data after BD-DCF and TVPG failed.
development_cohort.identity: Reuse the sealed PB7 SCIL result: 8/8 correct proofs, zero wrong proofs, zero UNKNOWN. OCR is not rerun.
development_cohort.ood_semantics: Absence of class-0/1 on the two large open mouths is only safe abstention. The model has no native OOD state and cannot earn an OOD-classification claim.

stop_rule: Run exactly once. Do not change author confidence thresholds, postprocessor, image size, class set, area or scale rules, NMS defaults, candidate ranking, Top-3, model, role truth, human boxes, or gate after output. Any failure closes this direct RGB door-ontology source rather than triggering a detector or threshold sweep.
next_step: If the gate passes, freeze exact SDOP and run one new entity-disjoint same-frame SCIL plus SDOP confirmation. If it fails, move to a different information modality such as relative-depth aperture topology rather than tune this detector.
claim_boundary: Development-only evidence on consumed PB7. Doorway or door detections are coarse current-frame proposals only: they do not establish a native NONE/OOD classifier, training-source disjointness, physical ownership, public access, opening state, traversability, active-view causality, temporal persistence, directional guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
